title: Enhance Receipt Extension
description: Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Module-specific fields for the Enhance module.

dimensions_present.description: Dimensions explicitly present in original input

dimensions_derived.description: Dimensions inferred without explicit user statement

critical_dimensions_resolved.description: Task + Target + Format all present or derived. Must be true before ScopeFrame runs.

questions_asked.description: Total clarifying questions asked (max 3 per pass, max 2 passes)

questions_answered.description: Questions that received a user response

vague_resolved.description: Input is no longer vague after Enhance. Must be true for status = PASS.

enhanced_input_path.description: Path to the enhanced input statement. ScopeFrame reads this.
